name: Trip.com Group Limited
tagline: Leading online travel platform in China connecting travelers with accommodations, flights, and travel experiences
hero_kpi_rationale: Equity method investments de US$2.4 milliards représentent les participations stratégiques significatives du groupe dans des entités affiliées, reflet de la stratégie d'expansion et de diversification via des investissements dans d'autres acteurs du secteur voyage

kpis.name_fr: Investissements en méthode de la mise en équivalence
kpis.explanation: Value of investments accounted for using the equity method in affiliated entities
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, equity method investments totaled US$2.4 billion, representing significant holdings in affiliated entities

kpis.name_fr: Remboursement annuel du dépositaire pour frais de cotation
kpis.name_en: Annual Depositary Reimbursement for Listing Fees
kpis.explanation: Expected reimbursement from depositary for stock exchange listing fees and investor relations program expenses
kpis.signal: Cost recovery mechanism from depositary for ongoing listing maintenance
kpis.description: Expected to receive approximately US$6 million net of withholding tax from the depositary for continuing annual stock exchange listing fees and investor relationship program expenses for 2025

stories_kpis.Name_fr: Sensibilité au risque de taux d'intérêt
stories_kpis.Explanation: Annual interest income impact from one basis point decrease in interest rates on cash holdings
stories_kpis.Signal: Moderate sensitivity to interest rate changes on cash holdings
stories_kpis.Description: Based on cash balance as of December 31, 2025, a one basis point decrease in interest rates would result in approximately RMB10 million (US$1 million) decrease in annual interest income

ai_positioning.Summary: Trip.com Group Limited is a leading online travel platform based in China. The company operates through multiple subsidiaries and maintains significant equity investments. Source documents focus on regulatory, tax, and depositary arrangements rather than AI capabilities or strategic positioning.
Evidence: Equity method investments of US$2.4 billion as of December 31, 2025
Multi-currency operations with significant RMB revenue exposure
Listings on both Nasdaq (ADSs) and Hong Kong Stock Exchange
Strategic focus on investor relations and capital management
ai_positioning.Source: Form 20-F and 6-K filings for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
